0.original: Lumull is vibrating with nervous energy.

29.original: Use the synthetic desensitizer on the lightning sprites.

48.original: One wonders how fearsome this Eyaney truly is...

49.original: If Treno's barrier is similar in design to Alexandria's, should we assume that electrope technology is standard here as well?

50.original: At the moment, Eyaney should be waiting just past that park.

51.original: Let's be off before anyone changes their mind!

53.original: Whenever we meet an engineer from some distant land, I can't help but wish to introduce them to our friends at the Ironworks. Such a firestorm of questions there would be...

55.original: They put one in mind of another pair of siblings we know, don't they?

56.original: <gasp> I entirely forgot to ask your names! Do forgive me.

57.original: I am Krile, and this is <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

58.original: Accompanying Lumull is G'raha Tia, our own technology enthusiast.

60.original: It feels strange putting you to work, but I'd be lying if I said I don't need the help.

61.original: In the wake of an event like this, I presume a great deal of labor is required to restore everything to working order...

62.original: The volume of fixes that need making is one matter, but I could handle it if it weren't for these legs of mine. The paralysis flares up at the worst times, I swear...

63.original: I can manage a bit of shuffling from one station to the other on a good day, but I usually leave racing around the city to my brother.

64.original: With him off to the mine, though, someone else needs to take care of the lightning sprites. They're drawn to the discharged aether of slain creatures.

65.original: I'd offer you the detector to make tracking them down easier, but seeing as Lumull has managed to break it yet again... <sigh>

66.original: I do have this, though. Toss some at a sprite, and you can suppress its ability to sense aether nearby. That usually gets them wandering out of the city towards more fertile ground.

68.original: We find it's safer not to. When threatened, they'll siphon energy from facilities we need to keep our medical services running, or emit bursts that overload nearby systems.

69.original: For the same reason, I recommend you stick to thoroughfares that will allow you to spot them well in advance. I would hate for you to be injured while helping us.

71.original: We'll want to split up again to cover more ground. Are you ready to go?

72.original: I appreciate the help. I'll be here working on the detector while you're away.

73.original: Though you scan the area thoroughly, you see no lightning sprites.

74.original: Though you scan the area thoroughly, you see no lightning sprites.

75.original: Lightning sprites! The time to test your tossing arm has arrived...

76.original: Guests are always welcome in Treno. I hope you're enjoying your time here!

77.original: You're back! Were there many sprites?

78.original: Just a handful on your route, then? Could be worse!

79.original: Still, it's important to keep the city free of them. We're much obliged!
